value.text: {"claims":[{"quote":"Over the past nine days we found 11 shopper posts (two retail-deal forums and a local-news comment thread) describing a $1.99 \"drop-off processing fee\" applied at checkout of the return flow for certain apparel and home items returned to carrier-run drop-off points.","tickers":["AMZN"],"entities":[],"kind":"channel_check","metric":"return drop-off processing fee","period":null,"value":1.99,"unit":"usd","direction":null,"first_hand":true},{"quote":"Two of the four seller-support contacts we spoke with said they had seen a new fee line in return-cost reports, but neither could say how many ASINs were affected.","tickers":["AMZN"],"entities":[],"kind":"channel_check","metric":"new fee line in return-cost reports","period":null,"value":null,"unit":null,"direction":null,"first_hand":true},{"quote":"Rough math: ~25% of U.S. returns go via third-party drop-off; a $1.99 fee on that share, at roughly 40% collection, is worth about $300-500m annually.","tickers":["AMZN"],"entities":[],"kind":"opinion","metric":"annual value of return drop-off fee","period":null,"value":null,"unit":null,"direction":null,"first_hand":false}]}
